item.description: A technical note on the Hierarchical Reasoning Model, the Tiny Recursion Model, and GRAM, and on where their training objectives converge with, and diverge from, diffusion models.

item.title: Self complete guide on Variational Diffusion Models
item.description: Why This Post Diffusion models are the state of the art in terms of generative models and I wanted to contribute in my own way with a self-complete article that summarizes the diffusion model training and sampling. The Model We define first some common terminology, then we describe the training and sampling process. Finally we define the most common ODE samplers used for generating data and we focus on the Classifier-Free guidance.

item.title: On The Solo Travel
item.description: First of all, I love traveling alone. But I acknowledge is not for everyone and I want to gather in this article a deep analysis of solo traveling, so that I might be helpful for someone. First approach Traveling alone feels uncomfortable at first, but it’s completely normal. Like the first time you stay alone in your room you listen new voices in your head you never met, the same happens for solo traveling.

item.title: About my painting "The Universe"
item.description: I started this painting back in September 2025 of last year during a particularly stressful time. I was two weeks away from a major paper submission deadline, spending day and night working at home. To relax from the paper I started working on a painting, for the first time with size 100x70cm. I started to work with acrylics. Even if it is stressful, I love making papers. I like the feeling of creating something new that can contribute to the scientific knowledge.

item.title: On the Aesthetic and art, beauty and horror
item.description: I am getting more and more into art, and this pushed my need to know more why I like so much art. Through this, I started to read about aesthetic as a branch of philosophy. Consequently, I organized my thoughts into this article Aesthetics At its root, aesthetics (derived from the Greek word aisthetikos, meaning “of sense perception”) is the philosophical study of beauty, taste, and art. It asks fundamental questions: What makes something beautiful?

item.title: Technical notes on MuLAN
item.description: MuLAN MuLAN by Sahoo et al. (2024) is a diffusion model built on top of Variational Diffusion Models that achieves SOTA on likelihood estimation on image datasets with the following features: Multivariate noising schedule (i.e. every timestep has a different noise rate) The noising schedule is described by a 5-degree polinomial Noising schedule is conditioned on a latent discrete variable, dependent on the input In these notes I tried to summarize the most important technical parts of MuLAN

item.description: The Purple Night Stars glimmering bright in the dark night, A solitary figure stands, absorbed from the horizon light. The ocean’s blue hue, a mirror of the scene, Reflects the cosmic wonder, ethereal and serene. In moments unexpected, life’s colors may change. item.title: Mathematical Details of Noise Injection in Diffusion Models
item.description: Diffusion process Let X0X_0X0​ the input image, the goal of the diffusion process is to gradually add noise to the image until its pixel values approximate a standard normal distribution. This enables a neural network to be trained to reverse the diffusion process and reconstruct the original image from the noised image. In this post, we will focus on the mathematical details behind the noise injection step of the diffusion process.

item.title: The stranger of Albert Camus
item.description: Introduction Two weeks ago I decided to read the book “The stranger” by Albert Camus. I was so impressed by the book that I thought about that for days and wrote an analysis of the book’s narrative and characters on my own. Now, I’m here to share my thoughts with everyone Part 1, an introspective journey Part 1 is self-centered on the protagonist’s actions, with a strong introspective focus to understand him and his thought process, while the second part is more about how Mersault’s actions are judged by the others.
